name: Helmut Marko
features: dark hair, sharp features, doctor of law, intense stare
bio: Graz lawyer, Jochen Rindt's schoolfriend, and the driver who set the Targa Florio lap record in an Alfa and the Le Mans distance record in the Martini 917K in 1971. In 1970 he shared the Salzburg 908/02 with Rudi Lins to third at Le Mans. A stone through the visor at Clermont in 1972 ended it.
